source: runtime-enumeration.json and repo-side lineage copies from /usr/local/bin

optional_tools_included.reason: present in runtime enumeration and same rollback/restore scope; included as optional lineage-only copy, not executed

entries.purpose: Find the newest backup-like file across runtime/config roots and optionally restore it over its target.
backup_writes: pre-rollback backup beside current target when --apply is used
entries.restore_behavior: Dry-run identifies candidate and target. Apply copies latest backup over target and may chmod executable or WireGuard config targets.
entries.routing_restore_behavior: Can restore WireGuard config or state files indirectly depending on newest backup; no explicit routing-sync observed.
entries.audit_behavior: Writes v7-audit-log rollback_last_change event on apply when available.
entries.temp_backup_behavior: Uses mktemp candidate lists and removes them; creates target.pre-rollback timestamp backup before restore.
entries.verification_requirement: bash -n only; do not execute rollback against live runtime in repo tests.
entries.special_safety_notes: Broad rollback tool. It can restore executables, auth config, identity DB, WireGuard config, V7 configs, or egress state depending on newest backup. It can restart systemd-journald for journald config targets and daemon-reload systemd service targets.

entries.purpose: Guarded placeholder documenting the future live-policy rollback contract.
backup_reads: operator-supplied nft-ruleset backup path readability check
entries.restore_behavior: No restore is performed. Command always returns BLOCKED_PLACEHOLDER after validating backup readability.
entries.routing_restore_behavior: None currently; intended future contract is nftables/ip-rule rollback.
entries.verification_requirement: bash -n only; do not execute against live policy backups in repo tests.
entries.special_safety_notes: Despite rollback name, current implementation is a guarded placeholder and intentionally applies no live changes.

entries.purpose: Rollback proxy runtime guard nftables state and optionally remove a runtime user created by apply.
entries.restore_behavior: Requires --confirm ROLLBACK_PROXY_RUNTIME_GUARD and root. Restores nftables from backup and may remove runtime user if it was created by apply and has no running processes.
entries.routing_restore_behavior: Restores nftables ruleset; does not call routing-sync/autoswitch.
entries.audit_behavior: Writes v7-audit-log proxy_runtime_guard_rollback event on success when available.
entries.temp_backup_behavior: Writes current nft ruleset into backup dir before restore.
entries.verification_requirement: bash -n only; do not execute rollback against live proxy/runtime guard state in repo tests.
entries.special_safety_notes: High-risk rollback tool. It mutates nftables and can userdel a runtime user. No systemctl restart observed.

entries.purpose: Rollback planned test subnet infrastructure rules without changing existing users.
entries.restore_behavior: Dry-run by default. Apply rewrites V7_VPN_SUBNETS in node.env back to legacy subnet and removes iptables NAT entries for test subnet.
entries.routing_restore_behavior: Deletes POSTROUTING MASQUERADE rules for test subnet, runs v7-killswitch-enable, then v7-killswitch-check.
entries.audit_behavior: Writes v7-audit-log subnet_test_rollback event on apply when available.
entries.verification_requirement: bash -n only; do not execute rollback against live subnet/routing state in repo tests.
entries.special_safety_notes: Optional rollback tool included for lineage. Apply requires --confirm ROLLBACK_SUBNET_TEST and mutates node.env, iptables NAT, and kill switch runtime.
